item.tib: dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyag
item.coloph: ces dpal gsang bdag gsang ba 'dus pa'i nang sgrub gab pa dgu bskor (skor) gyi brgyud (rgyud) phyag pad mo stong brtsegs 'di yang u0f38 rgod rje rgya yi rigs rus yin snang ba u0f38 tshe dbang bde chen snying por 'bod pa'i sprang 'khyams des kun bzang bde chen pho brang du snang ba 'od gsal rtsal sbyang gi thun 'tshams (mtshams) la sbyar ba'o//
